title: Family Portrait Outside Suburban House, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-1940s snapshot capturing three family members standing along a sidewalk path in front of a modest residential home. The woman on the left wears a tailored 1940s suit featuring prominent shoulder pads, while the elder woman in the middle wears a floral patterned dress, and the man on the right is dressed in high-waisted trousers and a broad necktie. The house behind them features decorative window shutters and a visible house address number above the doorway, evoking typical post-WWII American suburban life.
